## Context

Tasks 1–7 created the package: `src/common/msging/` has models.py, errors.py, ids.py (`make_event_id`), config.py (`ClientConfig`), spool.py (`Spool(spool_dir, max_bytes, batch_max_events, batch_max_bytes)` with append/seal), store.py, server.py, shipper.py (`Shipper(config, api_key, transport)` with `drain(spool, deadline_s)`). pytest.ini sets `pythonpath = src`; venv has all dependencies. You add `client.py` and its tests — the top of the client-side API: one EventClient per process, one SessionSender per session; the library stamps event_id/seq/timestamps and owns delivery.

One integration note: `Shipper.drain` treats `deadline_s=None` as single-attempt-per-segment; `EventClient.flush(timeout_s)` passes its timeout straight through as the drain deadline (total budget semantics — a recent fix made drain's deadline a shared budget across segments).
